_readme: Hand-labelled ground truth for `sv-engine eval`. See eval/README.md.

queries.query: a red suspension bridge over water
queries.note: Golden Gate, seen from a hillside path through foliage. Runs the whole standalone clip and shot 1 of the compilation.
Named-landmark phrasing of the same footage. Tests whether CLIP's landmark knowledge carries, where the generic phrasing above tests description.

queries.query: aerial view of a snowy peak against clouds
queries.note: Camera drifts over the ridge; sky and cloud fill the upper half throughout.

queries.query: the sun setting behind a dark mountain
queries.note: Within-video moment, not whole-clip: the sun is a visible disc above the ridge early on and is gone by ~7s. Deliberately narrower than the clip so the timestamp has to be right, not just the video.

queries.query: an orange sunset sky with clouds
riding a motorcycle down a forest road
queries.note: First-person over the handlebars; black and white footage.

queries.query: handlebars and mirrors of a motorbike
queries.note: Object-level rather than scene-level phrasing of the same shot.

queries.query: a black and white photo of trees
queries.note: Tests that the desaturated grade is itself retrievable, since it is the one thing distinguishing this shot's colour signature from the others.

queries.query: a winding road curving to the left
queries.note: The road bends noticeably in the last few seconds of the motorcycle shot, and runs straight before it. A genuinely within-shot moment.

queries.query: a dirt path through green bushes
queries.note: Foreground of the bridge shot: the trail and hillside scrub, not the bridge itself.

queries.query: a nearly black frame after dark
queries.note: The last seconds of the sunset clip, once the sun is below the ridge. Almost no visual signal -- expected to be the hardest label here, and a useful one to keep failing honestly rather than to delete.
